# Caddy — custom-to-root-context-sse

Proxy at /app/, app at root /, PUSH over Server-Sent Events. The prefix strip and the two response rewrites are unchanged from the WebSocket sibling; the added matcher refuses an upgrade with 501 before the prefix is looked at.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Caddy site block (`caddy/http/custom-to-root-context-sse/vaadin.caddyfile`), mounted as
`/etc/caddy/vaadin.caddyfile`:

```caddyfile
# Proxy at /app/, app at root /, PUSH over Server-Sent Events.
#
# templates/strip-prefix.caddyfile plus the refusal from
# templates/passthrough-sse.caddyfile. The refusal sits before the prefix
# handling on purpose: an upgrade is answered 501 by the proxy wherever it is
# aimed, and never reaches the backend.
:80 {
	import common

	@upgrade header Upgrade *
	respond @upgrade 501

	redir /app /app/ 308

	handle_path /app/* {
		reverse_proxy vaadin:8080 {
			header_down Location ^(https?://[^/]+)?/(.*)$ $1/app/$2
			header_down Set-Cookie ^(.*;\s*[Pp]ath=)/(;.*)?$ $1/app$2
		}
	}

	handle {
		respond 404
	}
}
```

The global options and the `common` snippet this file imports (the
access log and the compression allowlist) come from the shared
[Caddyfile](../../Caddyfile), mounted read-only over the image's own
`/etc/caddy/Caddyfile`. It imports this file, so the two only load as a pair.
